candidate_observations.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active and pays £18,000.
The five-year lease began on 24 February 2026 and nominally expires on 23 February 2031.
The tenant has an option to determine on the third anniversary of the term.
The virtual freehold comprises two 999-year leases at peppercorn rents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £18,000 rent was not treated as secure beyond the February 2029 break. Peppercorn superior rents were not counted as income and no guide was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: High Newham Court, Stockton-on-Tees, County Durham, TS19 8PD
observed_facts: The £46,334 headline mixes occupational rents, residential ground rents, a CCTV licence and a substation rent.
Units 22a and 22b are vacant while several other units are held on 999-year peppercorn leases.
Several occupational leases allow landlord determination on notice and Unit 31 includes a March 2030 tenant break.
The 27 upper-floor residential units are predominantly held on long leases rather than AST occupational income.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Vacant units and peppercorn interests were assigned no rent. Deposits were not treated as income and the £46,334 total was not represented as one long-dated covenant.
